newsitem.title: USA: Nev. 300 MW coal-fired unit seen shut until June 1.
newsitem.headline: Nev. 300 MW coal-fired unit seen shut until June 1.

text.p: The 300 megawatt (MW) unit 4 at the Reid Gardner coal-fired power plant north of Las Vegas will likely be shut until June 1 after it was damaged in a boiler explosion early Sunday, a spokesman for Nevada Power Co said Wednesday.
The company said Monday an investigation into the accident would take about two weeks.
The plant's 110 MW units 1 and 2 were operating normally, but the 110 MW unit 3 was off-line for scheduled maintenance through March 28, the spokesman said.
The Reid Gardner plant is owned by Nevada Power and the Califoria Department of Water Resources.
